bullets.text: New Subsea Cable Planned - **Farice** aims to enhance connectivity between Iceland and Scotland with the AUÐUR cable.
Bangladesh Telecom Crisis - Operators warn of potential shutdowns due to severe fuel shortages impacting services.
Satellite Deployment Setback - **AST SpaceMobile**'s BlueBird 7 satellite placed in the wrong orbit, hindering operations.
Deutsche Telekom Merger Talks - Potential merger with **T-Mobile** could create a $267 billion entity, discussions ongoing.
Arelion Expands Infrastructure - Upgrades at Nørre Nebel site to support more subsea cables and enhance Nordic connectivity.
